Although it is styled as a subcommentary on Śaṇkara's Brahmasūtrabhāṣya, it challenges several key theses upheld by proponents of Viśiṣṭādvaita Vedānta. See Duquette, Jonathan. Debates in the Delta: An Intellectual History of Late Advaita. Brill, forthcoming.
Kṛṣṇānanda Sarasvatī directs most of his criticism at Sudarśanasūri's Śrutaprakāśikā. See Duquette, Jonathan. Debates in the Delta: An Intellectual History of Late Advaita. Brill, forthcoming.
